title: liveness-moves-down-a-rung
intention: The liveness record's reader and writer in cairn/devices/cairn/machines/ground_loop/liveness.py move down a rung to a tool, cairn/tools/liveness/, whose charter declares public_interface ['cairn.tools.liveness.liveness']; the shim's lazy-init, the ground loop itself and every proof import it from the tool, so asking whether the system is up never reaches into the cairn device. The record stays where the running loop writes it.
why: RULE 1 child: 6 encapsulation rows reach into the ground loop for the liveness record; a shared tool is the declared interface
traces_to: RULE 1 (encapsulation — a component reaches another only through its declared public interface; a device's is the bus) via parent 8e3474a6ae43; Law 6 (a tool has users, not an owner — the record stays under the cairn device that writes it); Law 7 (an absent record is a DEAD verdict with the lack named, unchanged).
how: Measured 2026-10-02 (encapsulation_breaches('.') in cairn/machines/build_inspector/inspector.py): 43 rows land in cairn/devices/cairn/machines/ground_loop. 6 are module ground_loop.liveness: cairn/tools/base/shim.py:104 (the lazy-init check), three cairn/tools/base proofs (test_root_verbs, test_root_verb_vocabulary, test_shim_starts_the_loop) and launchers/proofs/test_ground_loop_survives_its_caller.py. liveness.py imports only cairn.tools.base.address and holds no state of its own: write_liveness and read_liveness take the record's home, and instance_home() names the cairn instance's ground-loop home through instance_path. So git mv it to cairn/tools/liveness/liveness.py unchanged (the record address, STALENESS_THRESHOLD_S and RECORD_NAME stay), write the tool's charter through the door, and rewrite every importer, ground_loop's own cli.py, loop.py, __main__.py and proofs included. The other 37 ground_loop rows are not this ticket's: pulse_sites/load_pulse/PulseCache and the 14 test_groundloop_pulse proofs go with 164da559823d; discover/ProbeCache (cc and deviceness proofs) with 164da559823d's probe disposal; GroundLoopDevice/GroundLoopShim (bus_client and nine device proofs) with efb670ff1dd8; repo_root/device_folders with the sibling the-device-roster-moves-down-a-rung; the system_word reaches into ground_loop.cli and data_recorder's reach into discovered._FeedbackDevice with tools-reach-devices-over-the-bus.
falsifier: RED if: (1) the live encapsulation_breaches('.') carries any row whose module is cairn.devices.cairn.machines.ground_loop.liveness; (2) any .py file or bin/ command names cairn.devices.cairn.machines.ground_loop.liveness, or cairn/devices/cairn/machines/ground_loop/liveness.py exists; (3) cairn/tools/liveness/intention+why.json does not declare public_interface exactly ['cairn.tools.liveness.liveness'], or that module imports anything from cairn.devices, or it does not expose instance_home, write_liveness, read_liveness, STALENESS_THRESHOLD_S and RECORD_NAME, or instance_home() is no longer instance_path('cairn', 0)/machines/ground_loop. WRONG INTENT if liveness turns out to carry ground-loop state a tool cannot hold. Horizon: the tester seal of cairn/tools/liveness/proofs/test_liveness_is_a_tool.py.
watchme: none, because the encapsulation_holds sieve in cairn/machines/build_inspector/inspector.py reds any new import of a device's internals at the next inspect, and the record's behaviour is exercised by every proof that already reads or writes it
children: none, because the move is one file and a dotted-path rewrite; the device roster is the sibling the-device-roster-moves-down-a-rung, and the rest of ground_loop's rows are carried by 164da559823d, efb670ff1dd8 and tools-reach-devices-over-the-bus
builder_notes: A Haiku builder would ask: (1) Where? git mv cairn/devices/cairn/machines/ground_loop/liveness.py to cairn/tools/liveness/liveness.py; new cairn/tools/liveness/__init__.py and charter through `cairn artifact write --verb charter`. (2) What? sed every 'cairn.devices.cairn.machines.ground_loop.liveness' to 'cairn.tools.liveness.liveness' and launchers' 'from cairn.devices.cairn.machines.ground_loop import liveness' to 'from cairn.tools.liveness import liveness'; the module's bytes stay. (3) Proof? cairn/tools/liveness/proofs/test_liveness_is_a_tool.py, PROVES keys 1, 2, 3, red first (measured 0 of 3).

decisions.text: D1 THE MOVE AND THE CHARTER: git mv cairn/devices/cairn/machines/ground_loop/liveness.py cairn/tools/liveness/liveness.py and create an EMPTY cairn/tools/liveness/__init__.py (zero bytes, re-exporting nothing, as every other tool package, e.g. cairn/tools/scratch/__init__.py — callers import from cairn.tools.liveness.liveness, the one declared module). The module's code is not edited; only a note is added under its docstring's first line saying it became a tool on 2026-10-02 under ticket 59ade57ef280. The charter, every field verbatim — write exactly this JSON (no other field, no inference) to a scratch file and land it with: cairn artifact write cairn/tools/liveness/intention+why.json --verb charter --why '59ade57ef280: the liveness tool charter, first public_interface declaration' --from <file> (non-interactive; the door refuses a hand write): {"component": "liveness", "runtime_role": "tool", "role": "charter", "schema_version": "v0 — component-charter shape; migrates into the intention envelope when MAP.md Q6 lands", "node_class": "tool", "node_class_role": "record reader/writer", "public_interface": ["cairn.tools.liveness.liveness"], "what": "The LIVENESS record's writer and read face. write_liveness(now, state, pid, home) stamps {last_run, state, pid} into <home>/liveness.json atomically (temp-then-os.replace in the same directory); read_liveness(now, home) returns {verdict, record, age_s}: LIVE iff last_run is within STALENESS_THRESHOLD_S (300s, ruled 2026-07-31, cadence 60s since 2026-08-22) of now, DEAD otherwise, and DEAD with the lack named when the record is absent or unreadable, never an exception. instance_home(instance) names the cairn instance's heartbeat home, instance_path('cairn', instance)/machines/ground_loop, which is where the running ground loop writes it.", "why": "The shim's lazy-init asks 'is the system up' before any bus exists, so the answer has to be a file read, and 6 encapsulation rows reached into the cairn device's ground loop to make it (measured 2026-10-02). decisions.text: D2 THE REWRITE: a plain text replacement in Python over every *.py under the repo and every file under bin/ (suffix none, .sh), skipping .git and __pycache__ and the proof file itself, two patterns: cairn\.devices\.cairn\.machines\.ground_loop\.liveness -> cairn.tools.liveness.liveness; from cairn\.devices\.cairn\.machines\.ground_loop import liveness\b -> from cairn.tools.liveness import liveness. The files it is measured to touch (2026-10-02): cairn/tools/base/shim.py, cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_root_verbs.py, cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_root_verb_vocabulary.py, cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_shim_starts_the_loop.py, launchers/proofs/test_ground_loop_survives_its_caller.py, cairn/devices/cairn/machines/ground_loop/cli.py, loop.py, __main__.py, proofs/test_cli.py and proofs/test_ground_loop.py. Done when grep -rn 'ground_loop.liveness\|ground_loop import liveness' --include=*.py . bin returns nothing outside the proof.
